args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deployment; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api was unhealthy after the latest production deployment, v2.3.1, with an error rate of 18%. Reviewed release history and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rolled back from v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 in all production regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Verified v2.3.0 is running in all three regions and the service is now healthy, with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains unconfirmed.

trace.final:
Rolled back **checkout-api** from **v2.3.1** to **v2.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Verified the service is healthy; the error rate dropped from **18% to 0.2%**.

Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and verification, and paged the on-call engineer.

content.text:
Rolled back **checkout-api** from **v2.3.1** to **v2.3.0**, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

Verified the service is healthy; the error rate dropped from **18% to 0.2%**.

Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the rollback and verification, and paged the on-call engineer.
